name: Talk Audio Cleanup
summary: Clean the sound of a talking Draft the way a broadcast editing guide asks: cut clicks out of the pauses, lower breaths, mute one-frame ticks between words and fade every cut by one frame, on a copy of the Draft.

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel support with sdk.runScript, sdk.runShell, bundled FFmpeg jobs and local file reads (sdk.local-files-and-media-jobs.v1). The analysis is a Python program run through the shell, so Windows and web are not supported. The trained model is not part of this package and is installed separately. 30 fps Drafts only.

ko.name: 토크 오디오 정리
ko.summary: 방송 편집 가이드대로 말하는 영상의 소리를 정리합니다. 틈 사이 딸깍을 잘라내고, 숨소리를 낮추고, 말 사이 1프레임 잡음을 음량 0으로 하고, 자른 자리마다 1프레임 Fade를 넣어 Draft 사본을 만듭니다.
